name: Effect ~Akuma no Ko~
source: Nagi Izumi has a normal life... except for a couple of things. Sei, a bullied girl in his class, has telekinesis. And his girlfriend, Mayumi, has the power to cure any sickness or injury. One rainy day in June, Mayumi uses her power to save a woman who attempts suicide...
translation: 泉凪过着普通的生活……除了两件事。他班上受欺负的女孩圣拥有念动力，而他的女友真由美则拥有治愈任何疾病和伤势的力量。六月的某个雨天，真由美使用自己的能力救下了一名试图自杀的女性……
